slides.title: Golf gets us started
slides.body: PGA Tour, Champions Tour, and DP World Tour all begin at 12:00 AM ET.

slides.title: Afternoon MLB
slides.body: Guardians-Tigers at 1:10 PM ET, Pirates-Cardinals at 1:15 PM ET, Mets-Nationals at 4:05 PM ET.

slides.title: Prime-time tripleheader
slides.body: Cavs-Knicks, Valkyries-Liberty, Tempo-Lynx, and Habs-Hurricanes all hit at 8:00 PM ET.

slides.title: Late MLB action
slides.body: Braves-Marlins, Blue Jays-Yankees, A’s-Angels, and Rockies-Dbacks close the night.

slides.title: Where to watch
slides.body: ESPN+, MLB.TV, ESPN, TNT/truTV/Max, Amazon Prime, WNBA League Pass, and local team networks.
